briefings.title: Industry Role Shortlist

scope.geography: United States; Cleveland/Ohio prioritized when a sufficiently strong industry match is available
focus: Organ-on-chip and complex in vitro/preclinical models
scope.selection_rule: Current actionable roles only; exclude stale postings and generic weak matches.

jobs.title: Scientist II, Complex In Vitro Model
jobs.company_info: AbbVie Immunology is hiring within its Complex In Vitro Model group to support inflammatory and autoimmune drug discovery using human-relevant systems.
jobs.posting_status: Active employer posting with Apply button
jobs.job_description: Design and interpret biochemical and cellular studies of drug potency and mechanism using primary human cells and complex in vitro models including organoids and organ-on-chip systems.
key_must_have_requirements: BS/MS-level experience threshold in biological sciences
Primary human immune-cell and tissue culture
Complex in vitro/co-culture model development
Quantitative assay design and data interpretation
ELISA/MSD, PCR, flow cytometry and high-content microscopy experience
preferred_requirements: Advanced 3D systems including organoids or organ-on-chip
jobs.why_good_match: This is nearly a direct industry translation of the user's Crohn's disease organoid/chip work: complex human models, inflammatory biology, quantitative readouts and mechanistic interpretation are central rather than peripheral.
specific_experience_to_highlight: Barrier, ROS, imaging and molecular endpoints
gaps_or_risks: The formal education/experience wording is written around BS/MS rather than PhD leveling
Direct immune-cell assay depth and flow cytometry may be less extensive than some candidates
resume_tailoring: Lead with complex human in vitro model development
Translate chip work into drug-discovery assay language
Keep microfabrication as a differentiator rather than the opening headline
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply now with a disease-model/assay-development resume and explicitly connect the Crohn's platform to inflammatory target and mechanism studies.

jobs.title: Senior / Principal Scientist, Lung Modeling, Complex In Vitro Systems Laboratory
jobs.company_info: Genentech's Translational Safety Complex in Vitro Systems laboratory develops and qualifies advanced human models for Development Sciences, Research and Translational Medicine.

salary.note: Current publicly surfaced range for the role.

jobs.posting_status: Current Workday posting surfaced with Apply
jobs.job_description: Design, develop, execute and characterize cutting-edge complex in vitro lung models to support drug discovery, translational research and safety assessment.
key_must_have_requirements: PhD in a relevant biological or engineering field
Strong complex in vitro model-development experience
Advanced imaging, transcriptomics and functional assay experience
Independent experimental ownership and cross-functional communication
jobs.why_good_match: The organ system differs, but the platform logic is almost identical to the user's work: human complex models, engineering, imaging, omics and quantitative validation.
specific_experience_to_highlight: Model validation across functional and molecular endpoints
gaps_or_risks: Lung biology is not the user's primary area
Principal-level expectations are above current career stage
resume_tailoring: Present the PhD as a platform-development program rather than a GI-only project
Signal openness to Senior Scientist rather than Principal leveling
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply as a high-value stretch and make clear that the transferable asset is complex human model development, not gut-specific biology.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist — Advanced Human Model Systems
jobs.company: National Center to Accelerate Cures / Blackbird Laboratories
jobs.company_info: This new NAM-focused institute is building validation, standards and regulatory evidence for advanced human model systems.
jobs.posting_status: Current listing surfaced within the past month
jobs.job_description: Advance regulatory acceptance and commercial adoption of NAMs by validating promising human-relevant technologies, establishing standards and generating evidence for regulatory review.
key_must_have_requirements: Deep experience with advanced human model systems
Ability to design rigorous validation studies
Cross-sector communication with regulators, technology developers and industry
Strong scientific judgment and documentation
jobs.why_good_match: Few roles match the user's NAM identity this directly. The strongest differentiator is practical experience building and validating human-relevant systems rather than discussing them abstractly.
gaps_or_risks: Senior title may assume broader formal validation/regulatory experience
Contract structure is less stable than a standard pharma position
resume_tailoring: Use NAM, validation, reproducibility and context-of-use language
Show evidence of technology qualification and benchmarking
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply if comfortable with a contract role; this could be unusually valuable for building a regulatory/NAM career identity.

jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.company_info: CTIBIOTECH USA is a preclinical CRDMO developing industrialized tissue-engineering and 3D-bioprinted human models for precision medicine and drug testing.
jobs.job_description: Support a precision-medicine CRDMO using primary human cells, engineered tissues, 3D bioprinting and reproducible preclinical assay workflows.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong mammalian cell-culture skills
Hands-on tissue-engineering or preclinical model experience
Experimental troubleshooting and documentation
Ability to work in a production-oriented biotech environment
jobs.why_good_match: This role uses the user's engineering plus wet-lab profile directly and offers a concrete route from academic organ-chip work into commercial human-model development.
gaps_or_risks: Direct industrial bioprinting may be limited
The company states that it cannot sponsor visas for this application
resume_tailoring: Show device and tissue images in a portfolio
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply before the September 23 close if work authorization is compatible.

jobs.title: Senior Laboratory Scientist, 3D Bioprinting & Tissue Engineering
jobs.company_info: This role is a hands-on laboratory lead for standardized 3D-bioprinted human skin and oncology micro-tumor workflows.
jobs.job_description: Lead daily 3D-bioprinting production, primary-cell processing, tissue engineering and client ADME-Tox/efficacy bioassays while supporting GxP-style lab operations.
key_must_have_requirements: BS/MS in cell biology, bioengineering or related field
About 5+ years hands-on sterile mammalian cell culture
Primary-cell experience
Technical troubleshooting and rigorous record keeping
jobs.why_good_match: The user's microfluidics, fabrication, patient-derived cells and troubleshooting background transfer well; this is more production-facing than the typical academic scientist role.
gaps_or_risks: The role may be operationally heavier and scientifically less independent
Formal regulated-environment experience may be limited
resume_tailoring: Do not oversell purely exploratory academic work
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply if a hands-on biofabrication route is attractive; compare carefully against the Research Scientist opening at the same company because that may offer better scientific ownership.

jobs.title: Scientist II, In-Vitro & Nonclinical Assay Development
jobs.company_info: Tonix is a commercial-stage biotechnology company with active CNS and immunology programs.
jobs.job_description: Develop and execute in-vitro and nonclinical assays supporting therapeutic research programs, with responsibility for robust experimental design and translational readouts.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong cell-based assay-development background
Independent experimental design and interpretation
Reproducible preclinical workflows
Cross-functional communication
jobs.why_good_match: Less organ-chip-specific than the top five, but a credible bridge into mainstream biotech assay development that makes good use of the user's model-development and quantitative biology background.
gaps_or_risks: The posting may emphasize conventional assays more than platform engineering
Disease focus is broader than GI
resume_tailoring: Translate thesis projects into decision-enabling preclinical studies
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply as a diversification option before the September 24 close.

briefings.overall_takeaway: No Ohio industry opening cleared the high-fit threshold this week. The strongest signal remains complex human in-vitro model development, with a secondary lane in biofabrication and a newly interesting NAM validation/regulatory path.
